items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: There was Red Perkins and his 8 fabulous musicians which was a unit.

ctx.x: Was Mr. Holland Harold a drummer?

Holland Harold, Tubby, that's right, and he taught me. He was the second greatest man. He was the man who helped me with my musical education and - I wasn't going to marry nobody. Then there was the Night Owls. There was Red Perkins and his 8 fabulous musicians which was a unit. Everywhere I turned there were people telling me I had to get married. I wasn't going to marry nobody. So finally after making 6 feeble attempts in 2 months, I married! I married June 23rd, 1933. I begged the girl; I said, now wait a…
I was married for 2 weeks and when the guys brought me home I said, "I'm married." They said, "You're crazy. You're not married." I said, "Yes, I am."
